title: Unanticipated broad phylogeny of BEN DNA-binding domains revealed by structural homology searches.
authors: Pan, Anyu; Zeng, Yangfan; Liu, Jingjing; Zhou, Mengjie; Lai, Eric C; Yu, Yang
one_liner_zh: 利用AlphaFold2结构预测进行同源搜索，扩展BEN DNA结合结构域家族并揭示其与同源异型域的进化关联，属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构注释研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但未聚焦结合机制建模。
abstract: Organization of protein sequences into domain families is a foundation for cataloging and investigating protein functions. However, long-standing strategies based on primary amino acid sequences are blind to the possibility that proteins with dissimilar sequences could have comparable tertiary structures. Building on our recent findings that in silico structural predictions of BEN family DNA-binding domains closely resemble their experimentally determined crystal structures, we exploited the AlphaFold2 database for comprehensive identification of BEN domains. Indeed, we identified numerous novel BEN domains, including members of new subfamilies. For example, while no BEN domain factors had previously been annotated in C. elegans, this species actually encodes multiple BEN proteins. These include key developmental timing genes of orphan domain status, sel-7 and lin-14, the latter being the central target of the founding miRNA lin-4. We also reveal that the domain of unknown function 4806 (DUF4806), which is widely distributed across metazoans, is structurally similar to BEN and comprises a new subtype. Surprisingly, we find that BEN domains resemble both metazoan and non-metazoan homeodomains in 3D conformation and preserve characteristic residues, indicating that despite their inability to be aligned by conventional methods, these DNA-binding modules are probably evolutionarily related. Finally, we broaden the application of structural homology searches by revealing novel human members of DUF3504, which exists on diverse proteins with presumed or known nuclear functions. Overall, our work strongly expands this recently identified family of transcription factors and illustrates the value of 3D structural predictions to annotate protein domains and interpret their functions.
abstract_zh: 将蛋白质序列组织成结构域家族是编目和研究蛋白质功能的基础。然而，基于初级氨基酸序列的长期策略忽视了序列不同但三级结构可能相似的蛋白质的可能性。基于我们最近的发现，即BEN家族DNA结合结构域的计算结构预测与其实验确定的晶体结构高度相似，我们利用AlphaFold2数据库对BEN结构域进行了全面鉴定。确实，我们识别出许多新型BEN结构域，包括新亚家族的成员。例如，尽管此前在秀丽隐杆线虫中未注释任何BEN结构域因子，但该物种实际上编码多种BEN蛋白，其中包括关键发育时序基因（孤儿结构域状态）sel-7和lin-14，后者是创始miRNA lin-4的核心靶标。我们还揭示，广泛分布于后生动物中的未知功能结构域4806（DUF4806）在结构上与BEN相似，并构成一个新亚型。令人惊讶的是，我们发现BEN结构域在三维构象上类似于后生动物和非后生动物的同源异型结构域，并保留特征性残基，表明尽管这些DNA结合模块无法通过常规方法进行比对，它们可能在进化上相关。最后，我们通过揭示DUF3504的新型人类成员，扩展了结构同源性搜索的应用，该结构域存在于具有推定或已知核功能的多种蛋白质上。总体而言，我们的工作大幅扩展了这一最近识别的转录因子家族，并展示了三维结构预测在注释蛋白质结构域和解释其功能中的价值。
